issues.issue: The '10' (10% non-inferiority margin) in the result text is not contained in the result field's own citations; it is supported by the endpoint field citation (line 753), so this is a near-false-positive but the margin should be cited in-field.
Automated flags for numbers '216017' and '216016' are false positives — these are NDA application identifiers, not efficacy/safety data.

Serious adverse reactions stated as 'occurred in 28 patients (0.6%)' but the cited SAE line reads '28 (0.6)' without a percent sign and the denominator/percentage interpretation is not clearly supported as a percentage in the quote.
Trial name text writes study IDs as '48,848-007A' etc. while the nct citation uses '48-848-007A' (hyphen vs comma), a minor formatting inconsistency between the two citations.
